name: Konkani Phodi
steps: Peel raw bananas and slice lengthwise into medium-thin ovals. Keep slices in water briefly, then drain and pat completely dry.
Mix tamarind with water, chilli, turmeric and salt. Rub this thin spice coating over all banana slices; rest until absorbed.
Mix rice flour and semolina on a plate. Coat both sides of every slice and shake off loose flour.
Heat a thin layer of coconut oil in a skillet. Lay slices in one layer and shallow-fry over medium heat until the undersides are reddish golden.
Turn and cook the other side until banana is tender and coating crisp. Drain and serve with dal-rice.
tips: Do not crowd the skillet; trapped steam softens the rice-flour and semolina crust.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
